courses.title: How to Play Drums for Healing
courses.description: A recorded course, made at a yoga studio in Encinitas, California, that teaches techniques on four drums (buffalo, ocean, djembe and frame drum) for meditation, sound healing and self-care. It includes practice videos, a guidebook, bonus sound-meditation tracks and a 30-minute sound healing session from Christine.

flags: The page cites her 2024 study on using drums, voice and bowls to reduce stress, pain and fatigue: pain and stress relief through practice, allowed; no disease named and no treatment claim.
Price is the full price; a two-payment option ($48.75 each) is also shown.
